Hydraulic Control Section
The rigidity of the valve body has been increased to handle the higher pressure of the hydraulic circuit. In addition, all solenoid valves are mounted on the lower valve body side for easier servicing.
Solenoid Names and Functions
Function Function
Shift Control Duty Solenoid No.1 (DS1) Controls the inflow of line pressure to the primary pulley according to the wheel speed and accelerator opening. (Controls the speed of upshifting)
Shift Control Duty Solenoid No.2 (DS2) Controls the outflow of line pressure from the primary pulley according to the wheel speed and accelerator opening. (Controls the speed of downshifting)
Lock-up Solenoid (SL) Switches the function of the linear solenoid (SLS).
Lock-up Engagement Pressure Control Duty Solenoid (DSU) Controls the gradual increase and decrease of the lock-up engagement hydraulic pressure.
Belt Clamping Force Control Linear Solenoid (SLS) Controls the secondary pulley pressure according to the input shaft torque to control the belt clamping force. In addition, it controls the forward/reverse clutch hydraulic pressure during forward/reverse clutch engagement and during neutral control.
